verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirmed that a machine-readable OpenAPI spec can be downloaded from the official docs domain. It returned HTTP 200 at docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json, and the payload contains the "openapi" key. This directly delivers the story. missing for 10: first-party documentation that describes or links the spec, and evidence of which API surfaces (Agent API, Search, Embeddings) the spec covers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
